name: Koriyama
summary: Koriyama City officially links a public SonicWeb GIS whose current JavaScript configuration exposes the 地番参考図 theme and 筆界 feature class 1021(th_18). Bounded anonymous requests returned native feature IDs and three full polygons. The city warns this is a reference map, and the API response does not declare CRS; runtime admission remains held.
